title: Repurposing Content — One Video, Five Platforms

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Turn long‑form YouTube videos into shorts, carousels, tweets, and LinkedIn posts.
Extract key insights and repackage them.
Keep platform tone and pacing in mind.

slides.heading: ONE → FIVE PLATFORMS
slides.caption: Adapt the message to the platform, not the other way around.

slides.heading: HOW TO APPLY IT
steps: Start with a long‑form anchor video.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Your best short‑form ideas usually come from long‑form content.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Posting the same edit everywhere without adapting it.
